title: Volume 1 Chapter 4: Dungeon Practice 1
content: In the curriculum of the Royal Academy, there exists something called Dungeon Practice.
It is a class where students apply the magic they have learned against the monsters within the dungeon.
Why would a school for nobles engage in such dangerous activities?
It’s all part of a tradition left behind by the Ancient Sage, or so the story goes.
All the faculty members are mobilized to ensure safety, but even so, it’s a practical lesson where one could easily end up seriously injured if they let their guard down.
In the game, there’s an incident where Alicia sets up a Teleportation Magic Circle, which teleports the character with the highest affection level deep into the dungeon.
I couldn’t help but wonder who would take on that role in this world.

The members of the reverse harem at the academy were a peaceful bunch, with Ekaterina occasionally taking on the role of the antagonist, throwing snide remarks at the protagonist. However, I couldn’t imagine that petty character setting a trap that could kill a higher noble.
“I’m so nervous! But I’m looking forward to it since I’ll be in the same class as Alicia!”
“Right? It’s good that we’re doing this together because it would be dangerous to go alone.”
Mariana, holding her sword with a tense expression, and Alicia, standing confidently with her arms crossed, were talking.
Seeing them in light armor instead of their uniforms was refreshing.
The scar on her eye gave off a vibe of a seasoned adventurer, and I couldn’t help but feel an overwhelming sense of excitement.
“Lagna, are you nervous or something?”
“Huh?”
“No, no, it’s just that it’s a dungeon, so I’m excited!”
That’s not it; I’m just feeling butterflies because of Alicia.
Of course, since this was a joint class, Patricia and the members of the reverse harem were also gathered here, and I had a feeling that chaos was about to ensue right from the start.
“Patricia, I’ll definitely protect you, so don’t worry!”
“Edward… Thank you, but I’m weak…”
“Hey, hey, don’t forget about us!”
“That’s right, Your Highness, we’re all here to protect Patricia!”
“You shouldn’t try to look good by yourself; don’t overdo it.”
“I’ll protect you, I will.”
The pink atmosphere unfolded without a care for the gazes around them.
…Is it really pink?
It felt like a ridiculous color was radiating from them.
The Dungeon Practice was an important event where, as a result of an incident, we would happen to discover a Holy Artifact hidden within. But what would that fake do?
“What’s with that equipment? It’s not suitable for a dangerous dungeon! You’re here to be protected, despite being a sage’s descendant?”
“Th-That’s…”
As I watched with a sigh, Ekaterina, accompanied by her entourage, immediately began to harass Patricia.
“But His Highness said he would go with me…”
“Hmph, are you underestimating Dungeon Practice? Do you intend to expose His Highness to danger? The lives of commoners and nobles are not equal, you know?”
Oh, she’s really playing the villain role well.
It was a bit amusing how her followers nodded along with Ekaterina’s words.
“Stop it, Lady Ekaterina.”
“Your Highness! But…”
“I invited her. I’ve heard that Patricia feels out of place in class due to her status. As royalty tasked with protecting the people, I can’t let her face the dangers of Dungeon Practice alone.”
“Ugh…”
Ekaterina’s expression twisted as she glared fiercely at Patricia.
Patricia let out a small yelp and hid behind Edward.
Since there were no Magic Bugs around, it was just a regular harassment.
“Instead of throwing around pointless insults, why not try to get along better?”
“That’s right, why do you think His Highness is taking the initiative to foster connections?”
“Sages’ descendants, despite the differences in status, were chosen by the Ancient Sage, so we have much to learn from each other.”
“Bullying is not good.”
Following Edward, the members of the reverse harem stood up one after another to argue against Ekaterina.
“Hmph! You’ve ruined my mood!”
The members of the target characters included royalty, dukes, and marquises—noble heirs at the top of the nation.
Overwhelmed by their presence, Ekaterina spat out some curses and retreated.
Watching the scene unfold, I thought about how it resembled something from the game.
The villainous Alicia was consumed by a desire for revenge and jealousy after being torn apart by the engagement cancellation incident, but what was Ekaterina’s reason for getting involved?
Could a petty character really approach royalty just because she felt it was inappropriate?
There was a lot of controversy, but I couldn’t understand the justification for going out of her way to throw insults at royalty who openly practiced equality within the academy.
While I could dismiss the discrimination against Alicia and me as just her bad personality, I wondered if this woman was also considering her future after graduation.
“It feels like the atmosphere is getting worse…”
“That’s just how it is.”
In response to Mariana’s confused words, Alicia, who had been silently observing, replied with a single sentence.
Since she seemed to have something on her mind, I quietly stepped beside her and whispered.
“It’s the complete opposite of Brave Territory. Here, no matter how bad the atmosphere gets, you won’t die. But in Brave Territory, the air is clean, and people die quickly.”
“…Pfft, that Brave joke is surprisingly funny.”
Huh? It’s not a joke; it’s the truth!
But since I got to see her smile, I’ll consider it a job well done.
“Is it really that scary in Brave Territory…?”
“No, it’s a really nice place. I’ll be going back with Lagna during the summer vacation, so if you’d like, you can come along!”
“Really? Is that okay? Lagna, this is Alicia’s suggestion.”
“Sure.”
That would work out better for Volzeia too, so I might as well plan to introduce Onyx as well.
“Oh, I thought I smelled something, and here we have a discarded land monkey and a commoner? This place is just full of misfits.”
Wow, Ekaterina was coming over here.
I figured she’d come to vent her frustrations at Patricia after being brushed off, but she truly was relentless.
As I pondered how to handle the situation, Alicia stepped in front of Mariana to protect her before I could.
“After being told that by His Highness, you really are a persistent woman.”
Her tone was different from usual; it was powerful.
“Ugh, how dare you, a discarded one, lose to a commoner! Because of you, commoners are running rampant in the academy! How do you intend to take responsibility for that?”
“I’ve already faced my punishment. I have nothing to do with it anymore.”
With her dignified demeanor, Ekaterina’s face twisted even further.
It wouldn’t be surprising if her face started to cramp, but what was going on with her facial muscles?
“Do you have any idea how much we’ve had to suffer because of your disgraceful defeat? I lifted you up so much!”
“You haven’t changed in your self-righteousness.”
“Ugh, you discarded one!”
“Feel free to look down on me as much as you want. I’ve done enough to deserve it. But it’s no longer my concern.”
Alicia continued with her resolute attitude.

“If you have something to say, then say it with all your might. You can challenge me to a duel or whatever. Although I don’t think you can win against a sage’s descendant, and frankly, I don’t care about your victory or defeat anymore.”

“How dare you, with your discarded status, think you can befriend a monkey from Discarded Land and a commoner? Well, you two are well-suited for each other! Just drink your coffee for the rest of your life!”
“I like coffee, so I plan to keep drinking it, you know?”
“Tch, this is pointless! I’m done! Ugh, it stinks of coffee!”
Completely brushed off, Ekaterina left with a look of frustration.
Just as I thought, Alicia was a strong woman.
Seeing her dignified figure made me like her even more.
This is bad; ever since we came to the dungeon, my heart hasn’t had a moment of rest.
“I’m sorry for getting tangled up with that weird person because of me.”
“You were cool. That’s what makes the Brave Family stand out.”
“Hehe, thanks, Lagna.”
“By the way, she was calling Alicia a discarded one. Should I kill her?”
“House.”
Woof woof.
I never expected to bring a collar into the dungeon.
Well, as long as she retreats disgracefully, I won’t intervene.
If she ever tries to harm anyone, I’ll crush her, regardless of whether she’s a student or a noble.
“Hey, Alicia… that person just insulted coffee, didn’t she?”
“Huh?”
“Hmm?”
I felt an unexpected killing intent coming from Mariana.
“How dare she insult my precious friend and even coffee… I can’t forgive that. Even if she’s a noble, I absolutely won’t forgive her.”
“Mariana, calm down, okay? Right? Right?”
Alicia was flustered by Mariana’s sudden change.
As expected of the coffee monster.
Despite everything that happened, the Dungeon Practice began without a hitch.
For some reason, we were the ones taking the lead.
“Well, it’s probably my fault.”
As I muttered that, I recalled the face of the examiner who glared at me with disdain at the entrance of the dungeon.
Was it a setup to disguise an accident, or was it just the initial clearing?
“I’m not worried about this much.”
“Alicia, I’ll protect you!”
Beside me stood a talented young woman educated in the magic powerhouse and a sage’s descendant who had passed the academy despite her status.
If we were in a shallow level of the practice area, it would be like a field trip.
“I’m looking forward to it, so excited!”
Dungeons are mysterious. Truly mysterious.
Where do the monsters living in the dungeon come from?
What were they even created for? It’s a real mystery.
This sweet, otherworldly sound made me incredibly excited.
“Lagna, it feels like a field trip, doesn’t it?”
“The dungeons in Brave Territory are even more amazing!”
We couldn’t waste time bickering at the entrance.
What was guarding the depths would come at intruders without mercy.
“I’ll take the lead and hunt them all down!”
The monsters in the dungeon drop something like a core when defeated, dispersing into mist.
That condensed magic is called a magic core.
For a world rich in magic and developed in sorcery, it’s a fairly important energy resource.
In other words, it’s a time to earn!
I had no complaints about living frugally with Alicia, but now that I knew there were various types of coffee, I needed money.
“Fufufufufu.”
“Lagna, you’re laughing a lot…?”
“Oh, don’t mind me. It’s just something that happens.”
“Is that so?”

“Right now, I’m like a borrowed cat in the Royal Capital, but in Brave Territory, I used to do all sorts of outrageous things, so I’m probably just excited since it’s been a while since I’ve been in a dungeon.”
You’re not going to ignore that, are you? This is normal in Brave Territory!
There are a lot of suspicious chuckles around, aren’t there?
“Well, let’s just say that. It’s actually true.”
In any case, it was lucky that we could enter the dungeon first.
Since the items needed to avoid destruction were hidden in this dungeon, it was the perfect timing to collect them.
“Alright, let’s go.”
From there, I continued to slay monsters as we advanced through the dungeon.
I cut down the monsters that appeared, punched them away, and kept moving forward.
“And sometimes I let one slip…”
“Is that okay? I think there are still people coming from behind.”
As Alicia watched a golem-type monster leave, she said…
“Patricia! Watch out! I’ll be your shield!”
“Don’t let royalty be the shield! Leave it to me!”
“My back is safe, so Patricia, come this way!”
“I’d prefer to be behind you, Lagna.”
“Then let’s have royalty and Patricia fall back!”
“Hey, that’s unfair, Edward!”
“That’s right, Your Highness! Let’s all protect her!”
I turned serious at the voices coming from behind.
“Since it’s a Dungeon Practice, we have to fight.”
“That’s true.”
“Is it okay for both of you…? Could this be the Brave Family way…?”
“No, we don’t do this in the Brave Family.”
I corrected Mariana’s confused statement.
We wouldn’t go out of our way to thin out the monsters.
If you were killed by the monsters you encountered, that was just how it was; it meant the ones who didn’t survive were weak.
“That’s right; we should be careful, or we’ll get in trouble.”
“Yeah, let’s keep it at this level.”
Sebas would probably scold us for being too lenient, so let’s avoid going out of our way to search and destroy.
We had accumulated a decent number of magic cores, so I decided to ignore anything that didn’t attack us.
“…The conversation is perfectly off-track.”
“Well, you don’t have to worry. We’re dealing with the most dangerous things in the dungeon.”
When I replied to Alicia, who looked exasperated, a whoosh sound came as an arrow flew from the wall, striking my shoulder.
This was the most dangerous thing in the dungeon, namely traps.
Adventurers often die from traps that come flying in from outside their field of vision while they’re focused on monsters.
But it was strange; there shouldn’t be any high-mortality traps in the levels where students were allowed to enter…
“Lagna, are you okay? That poison arrow hit you hard!”
“It hit me directly, didn’t it…?”
The arrow, laced with poison, clearly conveyed a murderous intent.
Was the target me, Alicia, Mariana, or all of us?
“I’m fine.”
My specialty in magic is barriers, which can change shape freely.
I can even form a protective membrane just a few millimeters around my body.
This barrier is set to prevent fatal events unconsciously, so I can feel safe even when ambushed.
Fatal events refer to objects with a certain speed or magic that exceeds a certain level.
“It looked like it hit, but it barely missed by a thin skin level.”
“You really have some incredible skills, don’t you?”
“I struggled at first, but after over ten years, it’s become like this.”
When I was three years old, I was wounded by a monster and hovered between life and death.
I was so scared of dying that I came up with the idea that if I covered my whole body, it wouldn’t matter if I was suddenly attacked in the forest.
At first, I had to do it consciously, requiring an intense focus that felt like my brain was going to fry, and I nearly passed out from exhaustion.
As a result of immense training and the bloody war called practice, I eventually became able to do it unconsciously.
“Wow, that’s incredibly meticulous and delicate magic!”
Mariana adjusted her glasses and touched my body curiously, breathing heavily with interest.
“Ahem, Mariana? She’s technically my fiancée, you know?”
“Oh, I’m sorry. I can’t help but be curious about magic.”
What do you mean “technically”?
I’ve always been like this, and I’ll continue to be like this.
“I didn’t realize it when you were in uniform, but you actually have quite a bit of muscle…”
If you fight continuously, you naturally build muscle for fighting.
On the other hand, since I didn’t do any office work, back then, I really suffered from tendonitis.
I truly felt grateful that Alicia came to my house.
“Just listening to it makes it sound like you’re invincible, but do you have any weaknesses?”
“I do.”
I answered Alicia’s question honestly.
“If I run out of magic, I can’t use it normally.”
It’s like a consumable; if I receive an attack that exceeds my magic capacity, it will penetrate.
Also, it’s difficult to perform magic that exceeds the range I can imagine unconsciously.
If Onyx, fully fed, were to attack me with all his might while I was asleep, I’d easily get eaten.
“By the way, does Lagna ever run out of magic?”
“Alicia, what do you think I am…?”
“Lagna.”
“Yes, I’m Lagna.”
That’s not really an answer, is it?
If I use it, I’ll run out; I’m human after all.
“Right, so if neither Alicia nor Mariana can use magic without incantations yet, how about we use summer vacation for some special training? Brave-style training.”
The magic academy doesn’t teach non-incantation spells.
Real combat magic is only learned again after graduation if you pursue that path.
Considering the future, it’s essential for them to gain some level of skill, so I plan to have them strengthen through Brave-style boot camp.
“Wow! Is that really okay? That makes me so happy!”
“P-Please keep it to a level where I won’t die…”
Mariana smiled innocently, but Alicia, knowing about the Brave Family, turned pale, imagining the harshness of the training.
“Well, I plan to have you experience a dungeon with a higher mortality rate than this one during the summer, so for now, it’s fine to just observe today.”
When I said that, Alicia bit her lip slightly, but I couldn’t let them walk through traps without any measures in place.
She might feel frustrated, but today, I would stand in front and protect them.
This kind of combat part is my main battlefield.
It wouldn’t even count as a warm-up.
As I walked, I noticed Mariana, adjusting her glasses, staring at the wall of the dungeon.
“Hmm…”
“Mariana, what’s up? Did you find a trap or something?”
“No, I was just thinking how mysterious dungeons are.”
While touching the empty wall, Mariana continued her thoughts.
“Why do the monsters in the dungeon vanish without leaving any corpses? It’s like they’re being absorbed, almost like they’re in some creature’s stomach, right?”
“Don’t say something scary.”
“Alicia, whether they’re living creatures or not, it wouldn’t be strange for a dungeon, you know?”
Amused by Alicia’s slight fear, Mariana began to strike the dungeon wall with a small pickaxe she had pulled out from somewhere.
Even I was left speechless by this.

“They say this was created by the Ancient Sage, but if that’s the case, could the entire dungeon be made of magic? If the walls are made of earth attribute magic, we might discover something if we break it and take it home!”
Thwack thwack thwack.
“I understand your feelings, but it’s better not to do anything reckless…”
Dungeons are filled with mysteries that remain unsolved, and it’s common sense that you never know what might happen.
Her mad scientist-like tendencies made me doubt whether she was really the former protagonist of an otome game.
However, my words fell on deaf ears, and her former protagonist traits were on full display.
“Interestingly, there’s said to be coffee produced in dungeons, and I’d love to try it someday.”
Thwack thwack thwack.
“By the way, can we cultivate plants from the natural world? I didn’t see anything that looked like it could grow naturally in a cave.”
Crack.
“What was that sound just now?”
“Down! Look down! Mariana!”
As Alicia shouted, Mariana looked down to see a magic circle appearing beneath her feet.
Alicia rushed to help Mariana faster than anyone else, and I read the atmosphere and stepped onto the magic circle surrounding them.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RLwYnX3.jpeg

I recognized this magic circle.  
It was the magic circle used by the villainous version of Alicia.  
I had intended to return the two of them to the entrance and come back alone, but I never expected it would turn out this way. Fate truly is a terrifying thing.
